name: 2v2 deployment robustness: frozen checkpoint, seed block, and mid-severity test matrix
authority: PI, 2026-09-06: 'use the fresh block 13400001..13400128 with 128 seeds per cell ... Use Rung 1 as the frozen checkpoint ... freeze mid severity only as the primary robustness experiment.'
amends: DEPLOYMENT_ROBUSTNESS_SPEC.json#TEST_MATRIX, which was deliberately left open: 'exact N/M/K to be fixed when the team-size training entrypoint and evaluation seed blocks are frozen'. This record fixes N/M/K for the 2v2 study and nothing else.
rule: APPEND. The frozen TIERS (severity values) and DEPLOYMENT_ONLY_GUARANTEE are UNCHANGED. No severity value is invented or adjusted here; this record only SELECTS which already-frozen tier is primary.

timing_disclosure.when: written before any 2v2 robustness episode has been run and before any seed in the block below has been spent.
visible_when_written: the Rung 1 frozen record and its verified checkpoint sha
a 1-seed plumbing smoke on non-scientific seed 99960001, since deleted
NOT_visible_when_written: any robustness measurement on the frozen block
any perturbed win rate at any severity

POLICY_UNDER_TEST.sha_verified_against: RUNG1_STUDENT_FROZEN.json -- match confirmed at freeze time
POLICY_UNDER_TEST.why_rung_1: it is the clean preservation result: its own crossover gate PASSES on both poles AND its within-seed comparison against the zero-sharing reference shows NO_DETECTABLE_WITHIN_SEED_LOSS on either pole. Rung 2 passes its gate but carries a statistically detected Pole-A specialization loss, so a degradation under perturbation would be confounded with damage it already has. Rung 3 fails its own gate and missed its fidelity band.
POLICY_UNDER_TEST.frozen: the checkpoint is NOT retrained, fine-tuned, adapted, or selected among during this study. Deployment only.

SEED_BLOCK.robustness_only: this block is reserved for the 2v2 deployment robustness study and must not be reused for training, ladder evaluation, certification, or any other purpose.
SEED_BLOCK.pairing: THE SAME 128 seeds are used for nominal and for all three perturbations, so every perturbed condition is paired seed-by-seed against nominal. This is what makes R_A/R_B below a within-seed contrast rather than a difference of two independent averages -- the same reasoning that motivated the matched-seed ladder protocol.
SEED_BLOCK.disjointness_verified: exact-literal grep of 13400001 / 13400064 / 13400128 and the pattern 134000[0-9]{2} against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/ and artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/: ZERO spec hits. Verified immediately before this record was committed.

TEST_MATRIX_PRIMARY.severity_provenance: every value above is the 'medium' tier ALREADY FROZEN in DEPLOYMENT_ROBUSTNESS_SPEC.json#TIERS. Nothing is invented here.
TEST_MATRIX_PRIMARY.one_at_a_time: exactly one disturbance family is active per condition. No combined perturbations in the primary study.
TEST_MATRIX_PRIMARY.episodes: 4 conditions x 4 cells x 128 seeds = 2048 episodes

per_condition_crossover.gate: PASS iff delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0 -- the identical criterion used everywhere in this program. No threshold is adjusted for the presence of a disturbance.
per_condition_crossover.question_answered: does crossover still pass under this disturbance?

paired_degradation_vs_nominal.question_answered: how much did the disturbance degrade crossover relative to nominal?
paired_degradation_vs_nominal.note: these two questions are distinct and are reported separately. A condition can retain a passing gate while showing a statistically detectable R, exactly as Rung 2 did against the sharing reference.

PRIMARY_QUANTITIES.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap over seeds, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7, seed as the resampling unit

DEPLOYMENT_ONLY.restated: perturbations are applied ONLY at deployment, by direct tensor assignment on the already-constructed core after reset. Training was nominal and is not revisited. No retraining, fine-tuning, adaptation, or checkpoint selection occurs anywhere in this study.
DEPLOYMENT_ONLY.guarantee_record: DEPLOYMENT_ONLY_GUARANTEE_CHECK.json (VERDICT PASS) covers the structural side: config defaults are zero and no training entrypoint imports the control-delay wrapper.

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD: low or high severity tiers (a separately frozen additive dose-response extension, only if time remains after the primary result lands)
robustness testing at 4v4 or 6v6 (neither has a frozen latent policy)
reuse of the 13400001..13400128 block for any other purpose
substituting a different checkpoint for Rung 1
SEQUENCE: freeze this record -> run the 4 conditions x 4 cells on the frozen block -> report per-condition gate AND paired R_A/R_B against nominal -> only then consider the low/high dose-response extension
